affine_clock_contract.unix_to_monotonic_projection: all-point affine offset envelope plus frozen uncertainty; causal intervals must remain non-overlapping

claim_boundary.database: single local PostgreSQL control-plane schema with synchronous_commit=on and separate-connection readback; no HA/DR durability claim
claim_boundary.runtime: single Windows/WSL2 physical host, one RTX 4080, controlled traffic
claim_boundary.transition: model-level Blue/Green continuity in one Triton GPU runtime; no physical zero-downtime or multi-node failover claim

db_happens_before_contract.actor_receipt: API/control-plane actor emits transition_id, old/new generation, fence sequence/XID/hash, process/thread identity and monotonic COMMIT ACK before returning the control response
db_happens_before_contract.effect_dependency: the held-Blue effect transaction must lock and read the committed switch fence row and bind observed transition ID/fence ID/sequence/XID/payload hash into the durable effect entity, idempotency response, causal event and receipt in one effect XID
db_happens_before_contract.proof_basis: commit-visible PostgreSQL fence read plus exact post-commit transition/effect readback; causal_sequence allocation and ACK timestamp order alone are explicitly insufficient
db_happens_before_contract.route_application: controller changes generation only after switch fence COMMIT ACK and separate readback, then returns an actor-origin route-applied receipt; runner phase timestamps are post-response observations only
db_happens_before_contract.terminal_rule: response success follows effect COMMIT ACK and separate readback; crash or missing receipt is inconclusive and zero-credit
db_happens_before_contract.unique_fence: transition_id is protected by a partial unique PostgreSQL index for switch events

matrix_gate: A fresh non-credit qualification and exact historical plus Strict V4 mutation set must pass before any fresh canonical matrix starts.
